stops.title: Enterprise Courtyard
stops.info: The open courtyard outside the Enterprise building, shaded by acacia trees. The walkway on the right leads to the next building.

stops.title: Brick Walkway
stops.info: A brick path along the hillside that wraps around the building. The lit entrance ahead leads inside.

stops.title: Main Hall
stops.info: The double-height hall inside, with the main staircase, standing tables and glass doors back out to campus.
